'''Lesk "Lightning" Alair''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who served with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], where he served as a trainer.<ref name="TOR" />
